title: Chalcone-9: a novel inhibitor of the JAK-STAT pathway with potent anti-cancer effects in triple-negative breast cancer cells.
authors: Lee, Song-Hee; Lee, Haeri; Kwon, Yong-Jin; Kim, Seul-Ki; Seo, Eun-Bi; Sohn, Jie Ohn; Kim, Byung-Hak; Park, Jung-Youl; Ye, Sang-Kyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究查尔酮衍生物抑制JAK-STAT通路抗三阴性乳腺癌，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-激酶蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Breast cancer remains the leading cause of cancer incidence and mortality among women worldwide, with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) posing significant treatment challenges. The dysregulation of the Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT) pathway contributes to tumor progression, making it a potential therapeutic target. Chalcones, known for their diverse biological activities, including anti-cancer effects, hold promise for drug development. This study explores the anti-cancer activity of (E)-4-(3-(2-(benzyloxy)-6-hydroxyphenyl)-3-oxoprop-1-en-1-yl)benzoic acid (chalcone-9), a novel chalcone derivative. METHODS: The cytotoxic effects of chalcone-9 were evaluated in breast cancer cell lines, including TNBC lines MDA-MB-231 and MDA-MB-468. Western blotting and qRT-PCR were used to analyze the impact on JAK1, JAK2, STAT1, and STAT3 activation and their downstream gene expression. In silico molecular docking analysis was conducted to determine whether chalcone-9 can interact with JAK1 and JAK2. A wound healing assay was used to observe the effect of chalcone-9 on tumor cell migration, and flow cytometry was employed to analyze whether chalcone-9 inhibits tumor cell cycle progression and induces apoptosis. The expression of apoptosis markers was also assessed. RESULTS: Chalcone-9 exhibited dose-dependent cytotoxicity in breast cancer cell lines, with TNBC cells showing higher sensitivity. Chalcone-9 effectively inhibited the activation of JAK1, JAK2, STAT1, and STAT3, outperforming conventional JAK/STAT inhibitors. The structure of chalcone-9 was confirmed to stably interact with JAK1 and JAK2 proteins. It also suppressed STAT1 and STAT3 target gene expression, reduced tumor cell migration, and induced apoptosis, as evidenced by PARP and caspase cleavage and decreased survivin levels. CONCLUSIONS: Chalcone-9 demonstrates significant anti-cancer activity, particularly against TNBC. By targeting the JAK/STAT pathway and promoting apoptosis, chalcone-9 emerges as a promising therapeutic candidate for aggressive breast cancers.
abstract_zh: 背景：乳腺癌仍然是全球女性癌症发病率和死亡率的主要原因，其中三阴性乳腺癌（triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC）构成重大治疗挑战。Janus激酶/信号转导与转录激活因子（JAK/STAT）通路的失调促进肿瘤进展，使其成为潜在的治疗靶点。查尔酮以其多样的生物活性（包括抗癌作用）而闻名，在药物开发中具有前景。本研究探讨了新型查尔酮衍生物（E）-4-(3-(2-(苄氧基)-6-羟基苯基)-3-氧代丙-1-烯-1-基)苯甲酸（chalcone-9）的抗癌活性。方法：在乳腺癌细胞系（包括TNBC系MDA-MB-231和MDA-MB-468）中评估了chalcone-9的细胞毒性效应。使用Western blotting和qRT-PCR分析其对JAK1、JAK2、STAT1和STAT3激活及其下游基因表达的影响。进行计算机分子对接分析以确定chalcone-9是否能与JAK1和JAK2相互作用。使用伤口愈合实验观察chalcone-9对肿瘤细胞迁移的影响，并采用流式细胞术分析chalcone-9是否抑制肿瘤细胞周期进程并诱导凋亡。还评估了凋亡标志物的表达。结果：Chalcone-9在乳腺癌细胞系中表现出剂量依赖性细胞毒性，其中TNBC细胞显示出更高的敏感性。Chalcone-9有效抑制JAK1、JAK2、STAT1和STAT3的激活，优于常规JAK/STAT抑制剂。确认chalcone-9的结构能与JAK1和JAK2蛋白稳定相互作用。它还抑制STAT1和STAT3靶基因表达，减少肿瘤细胞迁移，并诱导凋亡，这通过PARP和caspase裂解及survivin水平降低得到证实。结论：Chalcone-9显示出显著的抗癌活性，尤其针对TNBC。通过靶向JAK/STAT通路并促进凋亡，chalcone-9成为侵袭性乳腺癌的有前景的治疗候选药物。
